project.name: TWINFORGE — Process Lab
project.productType: Civil process simulation, measured calibration, predictive control and inspectable Meta experiments

typography.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
typography.mono: SF Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

design.density: Focused experiment workspace, concise controls, four measured metrics; responsive navigation and touch controls

preferredPrimitives: Native buttons, inputs and accessible segmented tabs
Existing Three.js renderer with deterministic measurements
HTML metric cards and canvas chart

must: At least 44px touch targets and visible keyboard focus.
Display only actual engine measurements; never copied demo values.
Identify recorded Meta responses separately from new API calls and local fitting.
Retain global forecast error and intervention flags alongside any supported subset.
Keep scanner video on device and require explicit camera access.
Distinguish image-plane pixels from calibrated physical units.
avoid: Implying real tank, phone or physical control validation from a simulation.
Assigning Meta held-out 3-second accuracy to interactive 5-second forecasts.
Importing a second UI framework for these patterns.

decisions: Make the civil two-tank comparison the home page; keep the previous physics workbench available.
Use the inspected 21st navigation, tabs, metrics and stepper patterns in native HTML/CSS.
Use orange for forecast/action emphasis, cyan for the controlled tank and quiet neutral reference.
Preserve the camera scanner as a separate local image-plane tool.
evidence: Four 21st previews visually inspected during the design pass, with code stored in .21st/cache.
Source names, registry URLs and hashes recorded in .21st/sources.json.
Actual CSS tokens read from web/process/lab.css.
Native adaptation provenance is named in index.html and web/process/lab.css.
